title: Represent exact retirement reservations by their identity and share settlement mechanics
evidence: Full file reviewed. ExactAuthorityState has only Live; cleanup_owners maps IDs to that single value, and scheduled_promotion wraps ID plus Live. Both settlement methods repeat the same master-gate commit_or_transfer, exact removal, retirement completion, notification, and fail-closed cleanup. All assigned connection and router tests are now reviewed; retirement coordinator tests outside this assignment remain the root auditor's integration responsibility.
proposal: Use HashSet<CleanupAuthorityId> and Option<PromotionAuthorityId>. A private reservation selector removes or validates the correct exact ID; one shared settlement implementation runs under the existing connection gate and the existing master-gate callbacks. Keep distinct move-only cleanup and promotion public owners and their different finish results.
required_contract_changes: None intended. Preserve exact identity, ordinary-versus-persistent-failure election, lock order, session/lease/promotion exclusions, condition-variable notification, poison handling and physical shutdown outside authority gates.

estimated_net_lines.basis: Source-only net after selector and shared helper plus allowance for focused verification; no savings counted from unread tests or unrelated master-gate implementation.

verification: Not run. Review and focused existing retirement, persistent-failure election, promotion/cleanup Drop and poison tests; prove cleanup and promotion exact-ID mismatch handling and waiters both before/after retirement.

title: Share shutdown bookkeeping while retaining the distinct retirement order
evidence: All bodies reviewed. The settlement methods duplicate Unsettled/Clean/Failed caching. Execution repeats runtime extraction with poison retention, driver stop/join, ingester join, page diagnostics and final hub detachment. Ordinary shutdown retires registry authority BEFORE driver join; terminal shutdown retires it AFTER driver join.
proposal: Share the cached-settlement wrapper and bounded mechanical join/final-detach helpers. Leave ordinary and terminal coordinators explicit, including their different authority-retirement ordering and first-error precedence. Do not replace both paths with an undifferentiated shutdown function.
required_contract_changes: None intended. Retain cancellation before acquiring the runtime lock, all joins despite preceding errors, exact generation receipt validation, worker admission release only at the permitted terminal cut, poisoned-handle cleanup and sticky failed shutdown.

estimated_net_lines.basis: Net source reduction after helpers and test allowance. No assumed deletion of lifecycle behavior or existing fault scenarios.

verification: Not run. Existing shutdown, service-failure, poisoned-ingester and forced-join-failure scenarios must prove physical retirement and retained error precedence; inspect related tests before implementation.

title: Reassess the broker's unused split construction protocol
evidence: All listed files fully reviewed. Production ProjectionConnection::new calls ProviderBroker::start, which immediately prepares, destructures and starts the broker. prepare_with_initial_start has only prepare and test callers; try_activate has no references; cancel_and_join has no production references. Build-error resource snapshots serve tests. Historical failure note cas-phase82-inert-adoption-ownership explains this protocol's adoption-era purpose. Current CAS-live/backend-runtime authority forbids retaining old service internals, but fresh unpublished candidate construction remains required and unimplemented in the paused rework. Construction tests have now been fully reviewed: page-pool/channel/spawn failures assert the exact retained resource snapshot until error Drop; cancellation and join of a start-blocked broker returns an unarmed worker admission. These prove current mechanics, not a current Operator-owned need to transfer those resources to a retained-service adopter.
proposal: Retain the dormant start/publication capability until fresh candidate construction is implemented against current authority. Reassess only the build-error resource-return and launch-escrow residue at that point, using direct resource-owned failure disposal if no target workflow requires returning those resources. This audit does not endorse deleting the split protocol.
required_contract_changes: Unresolved. Fresh unpublished candidate construction and failure/cancellation must still dispose and join every worker before reporting failure, with no publication before the whole-stack fence. Removing split preparation is acceptable only if the target candidate workflow needs no caller-held dormant broker capability; otherwise retain that capability and simplify only proven residue. Historical adoption requirements are not current design authority.

estimated_net_lines.basis: No savings accepted: current construction tests are fully reviewed, but fresh unpublished candidate construction remains an unfinished architectural requirement and must not be mistaken for dead code.

verification: Not run. All assigned broker construction tests reviewed. Any future simplification must prove pre-spawn and OS-spawn failure resource release, cancellation before activation, no ingestion before the publication fence, exact worker admission disposition and physical join custody. Current tests asserting error-held resources must be rewritten only after the target ownership decision.

title: Give the ingester one shared immutable broker context
evidence: Full declarations and construction bodies reviewed, plus all ingester operational files. ProviderBrokerControl and Ingester duplicate home identity/generation, authority/router/coordinators/commands/failure notification, cancelled/ack/routing/approval/steering state, page pool and test metrics; construction clones them into both records. The mutable receiver, current command, active ingress and authority_lost are ingester-only. Fully reviewed broker construction, checked-user, steering, compaction and residency fixtures exercise these attachments and exact release. No public behavior change is needed for the smaller context representation.
proposal: Have Ingester retain Arc<ProviderBrokerControl> (or a small shared context retained by both) alongside only its receiver and private mutable fields. Use explicit shared-field access, without Deref magic or a new actor framework. Keep shared context non-owning with respect to ingester handle so no reference cycle is introduced.
required_contract_changes: None intended. Preserve exact immutable connection/home/service attachment, shared cancellation and routing slots, non-cloneable ingress/receiver, loss mutex semantics and release of page/control references at shutdown.

estimated_net_lines.basis: Net declaration/construction reduction after explicit call-site adjustments and focused verification allowance. Excludes split-construction protocol removal AC-005; an implementation combining them must recount overlap.

verification: Not run. Broker construction/loss/cancellation and page-residency tests; check Arc ownership graph has no cycle and no reference crosses service replacement.
